description: Comprehensive binaural beat presets extracted from brainwave-suite.html

basePresets.description: Core named presets with detailed descriptions

presets.name: Sub-Delta Drift
presets.details: At 0.6 Hz, this preset targets the sub-delta range, often associated with deep unconsciousness and the glymphatic system's waste clearance in the brain. Ideal for profound rest.

presets.name: Sub-Delta Deep
presets.details: 0.9 Hz encourages a state of suspended animation, helping to quiet the mind completely and disconnect from sensory input for total regeneration.

presets.name: Delta Sleep Deep
presets.details: 1.2 Hz is a classic delta frequency linked to the deepest stages of NREM sleep. It promotes physical healing, immune system support, and the release of growth hormone.

presets.name: Delta Dream Drift
presets.details: At 3.4 Hz, you hover near the border of Theta. This state is associated with deep relaxation where dream-like imagery begins to form, suitable for pre-sleep winding down.

presets.name: Theta Restore
presets.details: 4.5 Hz is the 'Shamanic State' of consciousness. It promotes vivid imagery, deep meditation, and emotional processing, acting as a bridge to the subconscious.

presets.name: Theta Calm
presets.details: 6.0 Hz encourages a state of relaxed introspection. It is often used for hypnosis and self-programming, allowing you to access memory and intuition without distraction.

presets.name: Schumann Resonance
presets.details: 7.83 Hz is the fundamental frequency of the Earth's electromagnetic field. Entraining to this frequency is said to be grounding, promoting a sense of balance and well-being.

presets.name: Alpha Ease
presets.details: 9.0 Hz sits comfortably in the Alpha band, promoting a relaxed, detached awareness. It is excellent for stress reduction and 'taking a break' without falling asleep.

presets.name: Alpha Centering
presets.details: 10 Hz is the center of the Alpha band, associated with mood elevation, serotonin release, and a state of 'relaxed alertness'. Perfect for stabilizing the mind.

presets.name: SMR Focus
presets.details: 14 Hz (SMR) is associated with a state of calm, physical stillness combined with mental alertness. It is widely used to improve focus and reduce fidgeting.

presets.name: Beta Focus
presets.details: 16 Hz promotes active concentration and analytical thinking. Use this frequency when you need to process information, study, or solve logical problems.

presets.name: High Beta Drive
presets.details: 20 Hz pushes into high beta, stimulating high energy and alertness. Useful for overcoming fatigue, but prolonged use may cause anxiety in some.

presets.name: Gamma Spark
presets.details: 40 Hz is the gold standard for Gamma entrainment. It is linked to 'binding' sensory information, memory recall, and moments of high-level insight or 'Eureka' moments.

presets.name: Gamma Peak
presets.details: 41.6 Hz is a specific high-gamma frequency often used to energize the cortex and improve cognitive processing speed and synchronization.

presets.name: High Gamma Clarity
presets.details: 80 Hz is an experimental high-gamma frequency. It is believed to stimulate heightened perception and consciousness, potentially aiding in advanced meditation.

presets.name: Epsilon Stillness
presets.details: 0.2 Hz is in the Epsilon range. This extremely slow frequency is associated with states of suspended animation and extremely deep, void-like meditation.

presets.name: Focus Flow
presets.details: 12 Hz is often used for mental stability and 'flow' states.

presets.name: Deep Restoration
presets.details: 1.5 Hz is associated with pain relief and healing.

presets.name: Memory Boost
presets.details: 10.2 Hz is sometimes cited for memory retention.

presets.name: Creativity Burst
presets.details: 7.83 Hz grounding and creativity.

presets.name: Alertness
presets.details: 18 Hz for high energy and alertness.

presets.name: Profound Relaxation
presets.details: 0.5 Hz encourages profound relaxation and pain relief.

presets.name: Sleep Cycle Entry
presets.details: 1.5 Hz helps in transitioning from wakefulness to sleep.

presets.name: Emotional Release
presets.details: 3.5 Hz is associated with emotional release and feeling of unity.

presets.name: Introspection
presets.details: 4.2 Hz promotes introspection and inner guidance.

presets.name: Visualization
presets.details: 5.8 Hz is useful for visualization and problem solving.

presets.name: Pre-Sleep Calm
presets.details: 7.2 Hz helps reduce anxiety and prepares the mind for sleep.

presets.name: Stress Relief
presets.details: 8.3 Hz is great for relieving stress and mental fog.

presets.name: Mental Stability
presets.details: 11 Hz promotes a relaxed yet focused state.

presets.name: Active Focus
presets.details: 13.5 Hz is good for active tasks and external focus.

presets.name: Calculation
presets.details: 17 Hz enhances logical thinking and calculation abilities.

presets.name: Performance
presets.details: 23 Hz is associated with high cognitive functioning.

presets.name: High Level Processing
presets.details: 32 Hz supports high-level information processing.

presets.name: Perception Binding
presets.details: 42 Hz is linked to the binding of sensory inputs into a coherent perception.

presets.name: Hyper Gamma
presets.details: 100 Hz is in the Hyper Gamma range, associated with higher consciousness.

presets.name: Lambda State
presets.details: 200 Hz Lambda waves are associated with advanced meditation states.

highHzPresets.description: Ultra-high frequency presets for gamma stimulation

presets.name: 174 Hz Pain Relief
presets.details: 174 Hz is associated with reducing pain and giving organs a sense of security and love.

presets.name: 285 Hz Tissue Repair
presets.details: 285 Hz is thought to influence energy fields, helping to restructure damaged organs and tissues.

presets.name: 396 Hz Liberation
presets.details: 396 Hz cleanses the feeling of guilt, which often represents one of the basic obstacles to realization.

presets.name: 417 Hz Change
presets.details: 417 Hz produces energy to bring about change. It clears traumatic experiences and destructive influences.

presets.name: 528 Hz Transformation
presets.details: 528 Hz is known as the 'Love Frequency'. It is used to return human DNA to its original, perfect state.

presets.name: 639 Hz Connection
presets.details: 639 Hz enables creation of harmonious community and interpersonal relationships.

presets.name: 741 Hz Awakening
presets.details: 741 Hz cleanses the cell from toxins. It leads to a healthier, simpler life, and also changes diet to foods which are not poisoned by various kinds of toxins.

presets.name: 852 Hz Intuition
presets.details: 852 Hz is linked to ability to see through illusions of your life, such as hidden agendas of people, places and things.

presets.name: 963 Hz Oneness
presets.details: 963 Hz awakens any system to its original, perfect state. It is connected with the Light and all-embracing Spirit.

namedEnergyPresets.description: Named high-energy presets with detailed descriptions

presets.name: Morning Ignition
presets.note: High-beta for waking up the brain.
presets.details: A 22Hz signal to shake off sleep inertia and prime your mind for the day's activities. Engages active thinking.

presets.name: Cognitive Fuel
presets.details: At the entry point of the Gamma range, 30Hz is excellent for fueling sustained mental effort and information processing.

presets.name: Workout Prime
presets.details: A 38Hz frequency to increase physical energy and coordination, ideal for pre-workout or demanding physical tasks.

presets.name: Deadline Drive
presets.details: Push into a higher state of focus with 45Hz. Helps in binding information and maintaining concentration under pressure.

presets.name: Neural Sync
presets.details: 55Hz promotes synchronization across different brain regions, beneficial for complex problem-solving and creative insight.

presets.name: Quantum Focus
presets.details: A 70Hz frequency for moments requiring peak cognitive performance and the integration of complex, abstract ideas.
